# Triadic stopping rigidity and the finite entropy obstruction

**Full Collatz remains open.** Three parallel attacks developed the complementary-parity, entropy, and cycle-rotation literature into a complete decision procedure for a supplied triadic candidate, a finite ordinary-orbit obstruction to a local-statistics mixing argument, and exact full-denominator cycle tests. The packet adds **25 Lean statements**, separate written proofs and reviews, and a reusable verifier.

**Published commit:** `cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c`  
**Tree:** `6cc7e15fbf99d3407bdce77fa8c0ae83f2f42082`  
**Single parent:** `a7fd3ac9e5bff7412858df23d776bb847e9c1371`

[Start here](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/literature-round4-20261123/README.md) · [Exact sources and literature scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/literature-round4-20261123/SOURCES.json) · [Verification and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/reports/2026-11-23-literature-round4/README.md)

## Why this change

The preceding checkpoint exposed the exact original-source boxes behind residue collisions and the cost of the conservative triadic certificate. This round asks what additional rigidity is available from the actual dynamics. It refreshes PR178, PR180, PR185 and PR186 and reads the new relevant arithmetic and collision files at their frozen heads. The earlier 145-record repository inventory remains preserved; it is not represented as a new whole-branch proof audit.

## 1. The triadic denominator is an exact stopping statistic

For the shortcut map, an ordinary positive integer and a signed integer can have complementary Collatz parities forever only if they already form the pair `(1,2)` or `(2,1)`.

The Lean proof uses the integer rank

`E(x,w) = 3*x*abs(w) + 1_{x=1} + 1_{w=1}`.

Outside the two terminal pairs it strictly decreases at every compatible nonzero step. The indicator terms handle the two product plateaus. The zero dual forces an impossible all-odd original tail. Exact paired predecessors of the terminal pairs are unique.

If the all-time dual of `n>1` is reduced as `a/3^r`, its denominator loses exactly one factor of three at each original-even input until it becomes integral. The first integral pair is exactly `(2,1)`. Therefore **r counts the even inputs before the original orbit first reaches 2**.

Writing `tau(n)` for the first shortcut clock at 1 gives

`tau(n) < 3(r+1),    n <= 2^(r+1).`

The bounds hold for unreduced presentations too. The `n=1` and `n=2` cases are explicit.

### Reusable exact candidate verifier

[`verify_triadic.py`](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/literature-round4-20261123/verify_triadic.py) follows the unchanged original source at clocks `0,...,3(r+1)-1`. If 1 occurs, it pulls the complementary terminal value 2 backward along that exact path and compares rational values. It accepts exactly the supplied all-time dual.

```bash
python -X utf8 -B research/literature-round4-20261123/verify_triadic.py 3 -4 2 --include-orbit
```

This accepts `Omega(3)=-4/9`, recording `3,5,8,4,2,1`, with stopping time 5 below the bound 9.

The bound is linear in the number of ordinary steps, not a linear bit-complexity claim. Short parity matching alone is insufficient; the exact backward equality is part of the acceptance condition. A rejected denominator budget makes no assertion about later convergence.

**Formal boundary:** eight Lean statements include the all-time integral-pair classification and finite count inequality. The rational-denominator interpretation, its full stopping-time application, and verifier correctness remain written proofs, independently reconstructed by two reviewers.

[Complete triadic proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/literature-round4-20261123/TRIADIC_RIGIDITY.md) · [TriadicRigidity.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/literature-round4-20261123/TriadicRigidity.lean) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/reports/2026-11-23-literature-round4/TRIADIC_ESCAPE_REVIEW.md)

### Sharp minimum cost of the older certificate

The preceding conservative parity criterion uses

`H = 8N + (9r+8)L + 2`,

where `N=bl(n)` and `L=bl(max(1,abs(a),3^r))`. The written argument now proves that a candidate passing its own H is the **exact all-time dual**.

Among all successful N-bit sources and candidates, for every `N>=2`, the exact minimum is

`H_min(N) = 8N + 2 + (9N-10)*bl(3^(N-2)).`

The source `2^(N-1)` attains it. In particular `H>=9N^2-11N+12`, with leading term `9*log_2(3)*N^2`. Thus that conservative criterion certifies no sufficiently large source under any fixed linear deadline. This is certificate overhead, not a stopping-time lower bound. The exact-equality verifier avoids that overhead.

**Still missing:** a universally successful denominator selector. Increasing r without a proved sufficient bound recovers an unbounded search along the original orbit.

## 2. Exact local product laws can coexist with large actual collisions

The entropy attack produces actual finite positive ordinary segments, retaining full carries, original sources and empirical weights.

For a periodic positive gap template v of length d, with `2^A_v < 3^d`, let `Delta=3^d-2^A_v` and let b_j be its rotated complete carries. Every actual positive realizer `p=q_0` obeys

`2^a_j * (Delta*q_j+b_j) = 3^j * (Delta*p+b_0).`

This couples the ordinary segment to a negative rational periodic shadow. Coprime cancellation gives both:

- Endpoint residues modulo `3^m` depend only on phase once `j>=m`.
- Every original source pays `2^a_j <= Delta*p+b_0`.

A labelled de Bruijn period gives **exact forward and backward product statistics through any prescribed finite local depth** for a finite rational gap law of mean below `log_2(3)`. The full source cylinder and CRT realize any prescribed finite horizon; avoiding finitely many affine coincidences makes its states distinct.

For N samples containing a whole number of periods,

`collision >= 1/d,    ordinary diagonal = 1/N.`

N can satisfy the necessary exponential diagonal budget. The source floor, downward window ratios and complete carry quotients remain controlled. Within one phase, distinct original-source quotient boxes carry the cross-box collision; the preceding within-box injection remains valid.

### Executed example

The period `(1,1,2,2)` has `Delta=17` and carries `(73,101,143,103)`. Its four length-two patterns have the exact fair product frequencies.

At ternary precision 8, the replay constructs **4,106 distinct ordinary odd states from a 6,156-bit source** and samples 4,096 endpoints. Its collision is **1/4**, versus an ordinary diagonal of **1/4096** and **1/256** for the genuinely independent fair `{1,2}` reference. All 4,096 sampled original-source boxes are retained.

**Quantifier boundary:** the source changes when the prescribed horizon is enlarged. The exact binary divisibility prevents a fixed positive source from following this expanding periodic template forever. These are not escaping orbits or canonical harmonic-flow samples. The construction is compatible with PR180's new fixed-source stationary-limit collision gap.

**Formal boundary:** twelve Lean statements establish complete carry/shadow identities, both divisibilities, source-height payment, finite phase collision, and affine-coincidence uniqueness. The full CRT/de Bruijn ordinary realization and asymptotic sample choices remain written proofs.

## 3. Full-denominator cycle tests and exact root-count neutrality

For a chronological cut `w=uv`, with `d_u=2^|u|-3^ones(u)` and similarly for v,

`C(vu)-C(uv) = d_v*C(u)-d_u*C(v).`

At the least root of a primitive integral cycle, every proper rotated carry gap is a positive multiple of the **full** `D=2^A-3^p`. A gap strictly between zero and D excludes integrality. Five Lean statements prove this cut criterion, exact transport, divisibility propagation, and the necessary suffix contraction barrier.

The attempted cycle-lemma closure has an exact counting obstruction. For fixed-clock primitive words W, their full-D zero subset Z, and unique least roots R,

`|W|=A|R|,    |Z|=A|Z intersect R|.`

Consequently the integral proportion is unchanged by choosing a root. Its suffix barrier already holds with conditional probability one. Neither may be multiplied in again as an independent rarity saving.

The exact controls include a denominator-47 word with least gap 14, and a denominator-13 word whose gaps all exceed 13 while its full divisibility still fails.

**Formal boundary:** necklace counting, the gap gcd and the comparison with the stated external source-equidistribution window remain written. No unrestricted cycle exclusion or improved zero-fibre census is claimed.

## Literature and current source scope

Monks–Yazinski and Bernstein–Lagarias supply the complementary-parity framework. Hochman and Eberhard–Varju motivate the entropy/affine-law attack with their actual hypotheses retained. Halbeisen–Hungerbuhler's classical rotation and gcd results are explicitly credited. The cycle-lemma and first-passage comparisons do not assume independent laws after conditioning on a numerical cycle.

No historical novelty claim is made for the elementary deductions or classical identities. Newer working manuscripts are labelled source-qualified, with exact inspection scope. PR178 is pinned at `e6ed7f1429ced4b58b85ca9006edd9a3a12ca193` and PR180 at `a436db7b85f37abafea25f42d6f34afed02a29c0`.

### Exact published-commit checkout

After pushing, fetched the remote branch and created a fresh detached complete checkout at `cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c`. Ran `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py`, with the receipt outside that checkout. All five required commands exited zero:

1. `tools/check_integration_state.py`
2. `tools/check_review_integration.py`
3. `tools/check_review_integration.py --self-test`
4. `tools/test_integrity_portability.py`
5. `reports/prepublic-2026-09-05/integration-d/check_followup.py --self-test`

The checkout contained **512 tracked files**, the exact tree above, and remained clean. All **21** source/report bindings, **40** older Lean bindings and **7** compiled-input bindings matched. All **489** files from the parent checkpoint were byte-identical. Remote PR head, commit tree and single parent were read back.

The in-repository `CHECKOUT_VALIDATION.json` records the earlier clean science checkpoint before the two receipt files were added. The published-head check includes those files. Repository integrity is separate from mathematical verification.

## Continuity and open target

All **23 files** are additive. The [preceding whole-repository checkpoint](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/README.md), [closure round two](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/closure-round2-20261123/README.md), and [high-variance work](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/research/high-variance-20261123/README.md) remain intact. The preceding PR body is archived in [PR182_BEFORE.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c/reports/2026-11-23-literature-round4/PR182_BEFORE.json).

A successful universal denominator selector, a same-source collision upper paying all cross-box terms, or unrestricted full-denominator exclusion would still be a substantive closing step. This packet proves none of them. The PR remains an open draft on its existing base.
